title: A marker whose start never answered still cannot name its container after a restart
body: The crash window between recordAttempt and the new handle-completion write leaves a marker holding the pre-start placeholder, which carries no container name and no run_id/epic_id — so a resumed pass cannot inspect that attempt by identity (the executor and both fakes now throw loudly on it rather than mis-inspecting, which is honest but wedges the run rather than adopting or redispatching). The pre-start handle could carry the identity fields (run_id, epic_id, project, base_ref, title) and the sandbox executor could derive the container name and branch from identity when the persisted extras are absent, falling back to findWorkProcess for the id — making a never-started attempt read 'gone' and a booted-but-unrecorded one adopted by its derived name. The t5p acceptance (an attempt DISPATCHED before a restart) is met without this; this slice is start-never-answered.
